status: Implemented; final delivery/validation receipts accompany the canonical world
authority: Latest Studio export owns all supplied images, x/y positions, region grid, existing content and order
decisions: Stop the generated labeling image; no further annotation generation or correction.
Rename region Northeast district to Northwest District. It is the actual top-left tile.
Preserve local x/y on all six orphan locations while repairing their parent region keys.
Use ordinary native quests with one completion/reward owner. Triggers are for exact mechanical needs, not each conversation.
Generate and officially upload portraits for all 28 new NPCs; preserve all existing valid portraits.
Use default portrait style for ordinary new humanoids even when their occupation is adventuring. Five explicit exceptions: three creatures, captain and first mate.
Captain: tall muscular mature-adult fae woman, long hair, large butterfly wings, broad saber, gruff exuberance and fierce generosity. Independent adventurer/salvager.
First mate: hyperactive eager young-adult dragonkin woman; same adventuring/salvage crew.
Blue serpent: level 45, animal-like, sleeping at one fixed location; behavior can be studied. Not a roaming beginner encounter.
Giant turtle: level 60, passive unless provoked; peaceful shell care/injury/nesting quest route.
Kraken: level 55, bounded ocean roaming; do not move during actual scene, combat or after defeat.
Bookable small boats, optional owned boat access, and longer excursions aboard the captain's ship. Keep actual transactions in Marks.
Abbey follows one deity; choose a fitting original local religious tradition consistent with existing broader faith lore.
Add shipboard and abbey-related starts. Preserve and repair Brookmeadow's existing start.
The cliff is a quiet scenic date spot with no resident authored NPC, as specified in the export.
Do not alter Spider Realm content or launch other planned arcs/realms.
Nerathyl uses native Asleep/Awake named portrait variants. Select the author-requested corrected awake image; no automatic reset on return.
Use two linked native coastal questlines instead of two extra global arcs after the Crucible semantic budget probe reached 17/15.
Retain town/guild suggestion goals and ensemble-focused academy classmates; no player-centered reaction panel.
